entries.title: Fixed Open Ladder Frame Pedal Kart
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed open pedal-kart exterior. A full inclined column joins a three-spoke open steering ring. An independent pedal shaft has two opposed fixed cranks and whole tread pedals; one closed thick chain-band appearance joins two fixed sprocket discs beside the low seat. The seat pan, inclined back and risers are rooted on the chassis. This is not an old bumper-car shell stripped away or a bicycle given extra wheels: all low chassis, independent front carriers, rear axle and low-seated pedal layout are newly authored together; no old mesh imports. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal ground centering. One model and zero scenes.
